sources.title: Ceh Pech
sources.note: Pech family; Naum Pech Halach Uinik from 1470 at Motul; capital conquered 1538; letter of 1544; 21 of 25 towns in 1567.

notes: NEW STATE. Cliopatria has no row for this province; Later Mayan City-States (1429-1546, 135,136 to 187,745 km2) covers the whole northern lowlands and contains it. The Kuchkabal page says the extent of the provinces 'is still debated' and that scholars disagree 'on whether they were territorial units or jurisdictions'; the shape here is a disc around the capital, soft, and no frontier is claimed. Cliopatria keeps its envelope to 1546 although the Spanish took the provinces one by one from 1527. CEH PECH. Start 1470 is the founder's accession, not the province (the league fell in 1441); 1538 is the page's own date for the conquest of Motul and conflicts with the dates of the conquest page (1541-42 and 1546). The Pech family kept office later: letter of 8 May 1544, 21 of 25 batabs in 1567.
